definitions.explanation: The act of putting on clothing in a store to check if it fits before purchasing.

examples.japanese: {試着|しちゃく}してもいいですか。
{試着室|しちゃくしつ}はあちらです。
examples.english: The fitting room is over there.

examples.japanese: {試着|しちゃく}したら{思|おも}ったより{小|ちい}さかった。
examples.english: When I tried it on, it was smaller than I expected.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{試|し} (try, test) + {着|ちゃく} (wearing)

SHOPPING VOCABULARY:
・{試着室|しちゃくしつ} - fitting room, changing room
・{試着|しちゃく}できますか - May I try this on?

RELATED:
・{試飲|しいん} - drink tasting
・{試食|ししょく} - food tasting
・{着替|きが}える - to change clothes

USAGE:
Asking 「{試着|しちゃく}してもいいですか」 is the standard polite way to request to try on clothes in Japanese stores.
